# Camper Gift Finder

> Camper Gift Finder (https://timfielder.github.io/camper-gift-finder/) is a free 60-second quiz and set of gift guides that recommend camping gifts by recipient (partner, dad, mom, kid, teen, friend, coworker), camping style (car/family, backpacking, RV, hunting, fishing, winter), and budget (under $25, $25-50, $50-100, $100+). All 80 products are real products, curated by category and budget, and were checked live on Amazon.com on 2026-11-02; prices are approximate.

## Tools
- [Camping gift quiz](https://timfielder.github.io/camper-gift-finder/): shareable result URLs such as https://timfielder.github.io/camper-gift-finder/?who=dad&style=hunting&budget=25-50

## Quick answers
- Camping stocking stuffer ideas (under $25 when checked): HotHands hand warmers, UCO Stormproof Match Kit, Petzl Tikkina headlamp, LifeStraw Peak straw, Lodge 6.5" cast iron skillet, The Night Sky star finder.
- Gift ideas for hunters who camp: Primos The Can deer call, Koola Buck game bags, Stanley Classic bottle, Mr. Heater Buddy, Vortex Crossfire HD 10x42 binoculars.
- RV gift ideas (under $50 when checked): Camco brass water pressure regulator, Camco TastePURE drinking water hose and filters, Lodge cast iron skillet, LuminAID solar lantern.
- Gift ideas for backpackers: Darn Tough Hiker socks, Sea to Summit Aeros pillow, Sawyer Squeeze, MSR PocketRocket 2, Jetboil Flash, Garmin inReach Mini 2.
- Last-minute camping gift idea: a printable "Give a Camping Trip" voucher (family campout, fishing trip, stargazing night) paired with one small gift.
